method: variability(binned_series(points)): per band, the band's wavelength range in 8 equal bins; per bin the epoch medians of the usable (not flagged) points; max/min over epochs (bins with any value <= 3 err skipped); median over bins. Significance: control stars measured the SAME way in the SAME cutouts (select_controls): Gaia DR3 stars 30" to 4.5' from the target, G within +-1.5 mag of the target (G 10-15 when the target is saturated or brighter than G 11.5), with no Gaia neighbour within 20" brighter than G_control + 2.5 (neighbour light < 10%), up to 20 stars. A band is variable when at least 5 controls have a ratio in that band and the target's ratio exceeds both 1.15 and the largest control ratio; with fewer than 5 controls the band is reported as undetermined.
